instruction: Transform the receipt image at /home/user/OIP.jpg into a landscape PDF and save it to the Desktop as 'receipt_landscape.pdf'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting OIP.jpg to PDF with landscape orientation. Evaluator verifies: (1) PDF file exists and has at least 1 page (40%), (2) Page orientation is landscape (width > height) (60%). This tests the agent's ability to control page orientation during PDF creation, which may require rotating the image or setting page properties.
